candidatesAccepted.title: Check groomed-trail status before each riding day
candidatesAccepted.summary: Late January to February is usually peak season on the Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean Fédération des clubs de motoneigistes du Québec (FCMQ) network, but grooming and closures change daily. The authoritative sources are the FCMQ interactive trail map (iMotoneige) and the local snowmobile clubs; this note is not clearance to ride. Destination not answered, so no specific trail is assumed.

candidatesAccepted.title: Trail access permit (droit d'accès) for each rented machine
candidatesAccepted.summary: Every snowmobile on FCMQ trails needs a trail permit. Rental outfitters often include it, so confirm with yours. The price band here is a rough estimate, not a quote. Fines and closures are set by FCMQ and the local clubs.

candidatesAccepted.title: Cold-weather riding kit and first-timer briefing
candidatesAccepted.summary: Night lows can fall below −30 °C with wind chill on open lakes. Plan on a full snowmobile suit, a helmet with a heated or anti-fog visor, insulated boots, mitts, and spare base layers. Ask the rental outfitter to give the two novices an orientation. Ages and access needs were not answered, so the kit is not adjusted for them. Use Environment Canada forecasts and wind-chill warnings as the authority on weather.

candidatesAccepted.title: Lake-ice crossings: stay on the marked trail
candidatesAccepted.summary: Some trails in the region cross frozen lakes and the Saguenay fjord edges, and ice thickness varies. Cross only on club-marked, staked routes that are shown as open. The authority on these crossings is the local snowmobile club and FCMQ, not this tool. This fits the group's stated preference for groomed trails over going off-trail.

candidatesAccepted.title: Snowmobile trail access permit (FCMQ droit d'accès)
candidatesAccepted.summary: Riding Québec's groomed federated trails requires a trail access right per machine; daily or multi-day passes can be bought through FCMQ or sometimes bundled by the rental outfitter. Destination is not answered, so confirm whether your rental includes it before buying.
